label: component and function

text: With how far decompilation \[due to AI and all\] has come for games and other software
label: I had an idea: what if we built a detailed
note: organized reference for all of GTA V covering every script
column5: and documented what each one does?

text: The goal: give new and existing modders a clear starting point
label: so they know:

text: * what to edit to get the result they want
* what else a change might affect
Where it’s at: I started working on this solo
label: but let’s just say my token budget tapped out long before the game did 😅 Turns out mapping an entire GTA game is a bit much for one person and one wallet. I’ve made some progress
note: but not nearly as fast as I wanted. Here’s the repo:https://github.com/Goodvibes74/gta5-under-the-hood.git

text: So I’m hoping to put together a small group to share the load. Comment or DM me if you’re interested
label: and let me know what you think: I have made some progress and it would be cool if others jumped on board too.

text: It has been years since I modded GTAV
label: and I am feeling a new playthrough
note: so I'd like some mod recomendations please?

text: I don't care about graphics mods unless they have no performance hit. Preferably I would like mods that make the world more dynamic
label: adds a bit of immersion to the world itself
note: adds online content to the single player
column5: and also give me more stuff to do
column6: like more heists to do or something. I don't mind if they are for Legacy or Enhanced
